verdict.rationale: Conductor documents a programmatic API for managing cloud workspaces, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, no OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec appears in the evidence, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The hosted MCP server and llms.txt are adjacent capabilities, not a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
